title: Absorb g copies of the heavy slice by the factor-6 gate (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

The `g` copies of the heavy slice fit the factor-6 gate. For integers `p ≥ 2`, `g ≥ 1`, `K ≥ 0` and `C ≥ 0`, whenever `p ≥ max(64, 4K + 2C)` and `6 g ceil(log2 p) ≤ p`, `g` copies of

```text
(p^{10})^{g-1} p^6 (1 + p^4) exp(K p - p^2)
```

are strictly below `2^{-C p}`. The gate forces `g < 2^L`, so the copies add one `L`. For `p ≥ 64`, `8 L ≤ p`, and `48 L` becomes `6 p`. Six times the eighths is then at most `86 p + 48 - 24 p^2`. The polynomial `24 p^2 - 86 p - 96` equals `92704` at `p = 64` and increases by `48 p - 62`, so the exponent is at most `-C p - 1`.

At `p = 84` and `g = 2`, `6 g L = 84 ≤ 84` while `7 g L = 98 > 84`, and the copies exponent is `-6908`. This `6` multiplies `g L`. The coefficient-9 monomials in #4495 still use `16 g L ≤ p`, because `9 > 8`. At `p = 2` and `g = 2` the hypothesis fails. Since `e < 3`, two copies are larger than `1`.

A factor smaller than `6` stays open. The trailing bound `p^{10}`, the section error, and the ceiling `9 p^2` stay hypotheses. This package does not prove `||H^{-1}||_2 ≤ p^{10}`. No new κ. The selected record is `60403/20000000`. This answers the open question of #4667. It branches from fetched main and does not replay that unmerged package.

## Test plan

- [x] Prints `PASS_GAUSSIAN_SLICE_SIX_COPIES` and `outcome=completed`
- [ ] Maintainer replay was not run

Base `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51`, priority revision 7. Upstream fetched at 2026-10-22T14:56:27Z was that commit. The pre-submit fetches at 2026-10-22T14:59:04Z and 2026-10-22T14:59:24Z were the same commit, and the pinned blobs match. κ remains `60403/20000000`.
